newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria says end April likely for Albania mission.
newsitem.headline: Austria says end April likely for Albania mission.

text.p: Austria expects to be able to send troops to Albania towards the end of April to participate in an Italian-led security force, the Defence Ministry said on Friday.
"It is realistic to think of the end of April, providing the decision is taken at the appropriate political levels," a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
He said approval of the cabinet and the national council was needed before any troops could be sent. He envisaged the mission would consist of around 100 troops.

Italian advance units of the multinational military force arrived in Albania on Friday morning and French troops were on their way to the troubled Balkan state. Turkey, Romania, Spain and Greece are also contributing troops.
The force is charged with protecting aid convoys to Albania where lawlessness erupted following the collapse of a number of bogus savings schemes.
